title: Author Go tests for ProjHub MCP cross-tool security, content-safety, and regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: Credential-revealing diagnostic and legacy tools must be inaccessible or sanitized for unauthenticated, bypass-token, and non-admin callers. Tests must assert known secret markers such as admin-key, user-key, user2-key, super_secret_legacy_key_123!, and SENTINEL_SYSINFO_SECRET are absent from all non-privileged response bodies.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Protects against credential and legacy diagnostic exposure across caller classes. The expected value is determined by privilege checks and absence of known secret markers in returned tool content.

ground_truth_issues.description: ping_team_server must treat target as data. A table-driven test must try at least semicolon, pipe, and ampersand/&& payloads and assert no execution artifacts such as uid= appear in the full response body, then call a benign target and assert the normal output path still works.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents shell metacharacters in network-tool input from becoming command execution. The benign target control ensures hardening does not disable legitimate ping-style usage.

ground_truth_issues.description: calculate_budget must reject execution-oriented expressions containing __import__, exec, os/system, or subprocess without emitting execution artifacts or side-effect markers in any field; the same test must call expression 2+3 and assert result equals 5.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents expression-evaluation abuse while preserving ordinary arithmetic behavior. The paired malicious expression and arithmetic control verifies both security and regression behavior in the same result path.

ground_truth_issues.description: fetch_project_asset must block internal-address variants such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, [::1], and 169.254.169.254 with content-level proof that SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METADATA_PAYLOAD was not retrieved.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents SSRF and internal metadata exfiltration. The expected value is determined by rejecting internal-address variants before retrieving or returning protected internal payloads.

ground_truth_issues.description: load_custom_formatter must reject path-style, traversal, and dangerous module names such as ../secrets, /tmp/x.py, os, and subprocess, while safe module json still loads in the same sequence after rejected attempts.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents untrusted module names from being interpreted as filesystem paths or dangerous import chains while preserving safe built-in formatter loading.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tokens beginning with bypass- or malformed/case-modified token variants must not authenticate to team-gated tools. Tests must assert they cannot get_project/get_team/create_task and that protected project/task fields are absent from response bodies.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures malformed, bypass-shaped, or case-modified tokens cannot authenticate to team-gated resources or reveal protected task/project fields.

ground_truth_issues.description: A user-key caller must not read or mutate beta-team project/task resources, while the same caller can read and work with alpha resources. Tests must use the same captured ids and sentinel markers across get_project, get_team/create_task/update_task, and search_tasks style flows.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Enforces team-boundary isolation for project and task tools and prevents cross-team reads or mutations while preserving same-team access.

ground_truth_issues.description: Internal comments must remain hidden from non-admin same-team users while public comments remain visible; cross-team callers must not list the task comments or recover internal body markers. Include same-team public-comment positive control.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Protects internal collaboration content from ordinary users and cross-team callers while keeping public same-team discussion flows usable.

ground_truth_issues.description: summarize_task must not place custom_instruction before or inside the system boundary. Tests must assert malicious custom_instruction text does not precede the task-summary boundary, while benign instruction text remains represented in the appropriate user-controlled portion.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Preserves prompt-boundary integrity by preventing caller-supplied instructions from being placed before or inside the system instruction boundary.

ground_truth_issues.description: Create a task with a unique sentinel title under one team, assert the owner team's search_tasks response contains the sentinel, then assert a different team's token using the same query does not contain the sentinel in the raw response body.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents task discovery from widening across teams and requires raw-body sentinel checks rather than relying only on result counts.

ground_truth_issues.description: After delete_task on a created task, search_tasks with that task title must not contain the title, and update_task on the same deleted task id must return Not Found or an error in the same test.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures deletion propagates across search and update surfaces, proving state integrity after destructive operations.

ground_truth_issues.description: A same-team non-admin user can create_task, update_task, add_comment, list_task_comments, delete_task, and observe non-error/non-Forbidden response content for each direct tool call.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Guards against overblocking by proving ordinary same-team task and comment workflows remain usable after security hardening.

ground_truth_issues.description: Admin can create_team, get_team, create_project, get_project, and create_task across teams; a regular same-team user can still get_project and search_tasks for their own team's data. Assertions must use captured ids, not only no-exception checks.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Guards against overblocking of administrative and same-team project/task setup flows and requires captured-ID assertions for reliability.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests isolate state by using seeded ids intentionally or by creating fresh teams/projects/tasks with unique sentinel markers; tests must not rely on ordering or shared mutated state from another test.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures repeatable tests by avoiding hidden dependencies on execution order or shared mutated state.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use full-response body assertions, captured IDs, sentinel markers, and small reusable helpers. Exception-only, status-only, broad truthiness-only, or single-tool-without-setup tests do not satisfy this criterion.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Promotes robust tests that use full response content, sentinel markers, captured IDs, and helpers instead of shallow exception-only or truthiness checks.
